title: Websites and APIs by URL (passive GET, TLS handshake and DNS, for hosts the organization proved it controls)
readScopes: None: the collector reads what any browser sees. Each host must first be proven: a TXT record at _sagentix-collector.<host> holding sagentix-collector-verification=<token>, or https://<host>/.well-known/sagentix-collector.txt holding that line, with the token sos-app issued.

checks.title: The site refuses TLS 1.0 and 1.1 and negotiates TLS 1.2 or 1.3
checks.scope: Port 443 of each declared host: one handshake offering only TLS 1.0 and 1.1, one default handshake. Cipher suites are not judged.

checks.title: The certificate verifies for the host name and has more than 14 days left
checks.scope: The certificate the host presents on port 443, verified against Node's trust store; the days left are configurable.

checks.title: Plain HTTP redirects to HTTPS on the same host
checks.scope: One GET of the http:// form of each declared URL, redirect not followed; port 80 refusing connections also passes.

checks.title: HSTS is sent with max-age of at least one year
checks.scope: The Strict-Transport-Security header of the HTTPS answer for the declared URL only; other paths may differ.

checks.title: An enforced Content-Security-Policy restricts scripts, without 'unsafe-inline' unless a nonce or hash is given
checks.scope: The headers of the declared URL; a policy set in a <meta> tag is not read.

checks.title: X-Content-Type-Options is nosniff
checks.scope: The headers of the declared URL.

checks.title: Framing is restricted by CSP frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options DENY or SAMEORIGIN
checks.scope: The headers of the declared URL.

checks.title: A Referrer-Policy is set that does not send full URLs to other sites
checks.scope: The headers of the declared URL; the last policy browsers know is the one judged.

checks.title: No software version is shown in Server, X-Powered-By or X-AspNet-Version
checks.scope: The headers of the declared URL; error pages and other paths are not read.

checks.title: The mail domain publishes one SPF record ending in -all or ~all
checks.scope: The TXT records of the mail domain; include and redirect targets are not followed.

checks.title: The mail domain publishes DMARC with p=quarantine or p=reject for all mail
checks.scope: _dmarc of the mail domain, then of its parents down to two labels (an approximation of RFC 7489's Organizational Domain without the Public Suffix List).

checks.title: The domain is signed with DNSSEC (a DS record exists at the parent); recommended
checks.scope: A DS lookup by DNS over HTTPS (cloudflare-dns.com); whether resolvers validate the chain is not tested.

checks.title: The domain limits which certificate authorities may issue for it (CAA); recommended
checks.scope: The CAA record set at the domain or its nearest parent that has one (RFC 8659 section 3).
